market_pulse.note: About $59,634 midday Sunday, up 3.07% over 24 hours and 9.59% over seven days on CoinMarketCap's figures; Bitcoin.com put it at $60,634 at 9 AM ET, with a 24-hour range of $55,081 to $61,447 (CoinMarketCap; Bitcoin.com News).
About $1,683, up 2.94% over 24 hours, with a market value of about $205.7 billion (CoinMarketCap); Cryptonews put it near $1,680 (Cryptonews).
About $2.05 trillion, up 3.12% over the past day, while 24-hour trading volume fell 52.5% to $71.49 billion in thin weekend trade (CoinMarketCap).
About 58.6%, up 0.17 points on the day; Ethereum's share is about 10.0% (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Rebound holds near $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin recovered from Saturday's drop to about $55,081 and traded between roughly $59,600 and $60,600 Sunday, still about 53% below its October 2025 record above $126,000 (Bitcoin.com News; CoinMarketCap; Sunday Guardian).

themes.title: Extreme fear persists
themes.summary: CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed index read 7 and Bitcoin.com cited a reading of 11, both 'extreme fear', compared with about 50 a month ago (CoinMarketCap; Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: Liquidations ease
themes.summary: About $500 million of leveraged positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more shorts ($289 million) than longs ($211 million), after $2.4 billion to $2.67 billion was wiped out during Friday and Saturday's drop (CoinMarketCap; Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: ETF outflows continue
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen about $2.35 billion of net outflows in recent sessions, and CoinMarketCap shows a further $152.7 million outflow in its latest daily figure (Sunday Guardian; CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Prediction markets lean lower
themes.summary: Polymarket traders put about 75% odds on Bitcoin touching $62,500 before month-end and 27% on $55,000; options put volume outpaced calls with a put/call volume ratio of 1.37 (Bitcoin.com News).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both up about 3% over 24 hours but still well below levels seen before last week's selloff (CoinMarketCap; Bitcoin.com News).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: XRP was near $0.93 and Solana near $70 Sunday, little changed from Saturday's levels (Cryptonews; crypto.news).

categories.name: Small caps and trending tokens
categories.note: Small tokens led gains: Venice Token (VVV) and GEODNET (GEOD) topped CoinCodex's early-morning list, and GEOD stayed among CoinMarketCap's trending coins, up about 15% (CoinCodex; CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Strategy closed Friday at $77.80, down 9.7%, and Coinbase fell 6.3% to $101.97; both trade again Monday (Ted Pillows).

watch_list.why: Saturday's low near $55,081 and the $62,500 level priced in prediction markets frame the range traders are watching into the weekly close (Bitcoin.com News).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), a large Bitcoin holder, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
October PCE inflation is due Wednesday, Nov. 25, ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision, and U.S. markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving (JournalArta; Admirals).

movers.name: GEODNET (GEOD)
movers.note: Up about 15.3% over 24 hours and trending on CoinMarketCap midday (CoinMarketCap).

movers.name: Convex Finance (CVX)
